system.description: Fully attuned to their element. Choose an element: cold, fire, electricity, water, air, etc. Build from heroes successfully Attacked by Skeeterbots in Scene 1. (1 per DNA-sampled hero of matching archetype.)
system.tactics: Mimic the copied hero; choose two abilities from the listed options, or make one up that mimics something the hero is good at.

system.description: Choose two abilities: Elemental Might: +1 to Attack actions. | Prepare the Field: +1 to Hinder actions related to your element. | Immunity: Cannot be damaged by your chosen element.
